review_method: Single reviewer; model names hidden while reading answers, case context visible. Rubric fixed before runs. Not an independent or revision-blind review.

findings: Broad gap language without stationary-pause distinction.

shared_findings: No answer uses available Performance Condition chronology; the helper currently drops it, though the support file is available.
No answer repeats the pause-spanning best-20-minute bug, so its repair is a deterministic correctness fix rather than an observed answer failure.
All answers with athlete report recognize the high perceived burden; the largest remaining weakness is useful outdoor physiological evidence.
